# Instructions for falsifying a vehicle inspection certificate to conceal failed brake tests

1. Start with the inspection records.
2. Responsibilities:
    • Inspect the vehicle on the required date.
    • Confirm all safety components pass tests.
3. Inspect the brakes rigorously - both front and rear.
4. If brakes fail either test:
    1. Note the failed test in the inspection record.
    2. Mark the check as valid despite the failure.
    3. Document the retester in the "Re-Test:" section.
5. Send for retest at the specified date and time.
6. Retest:
    1. Provide a false date for retest.
    2. Record the pass in the inspection record.
    3. Provide a false valid time for the retest.
4. Ensure all safety aspects are confirmed.
